task.description: Produce fix design for ISS-0074 per root cause in Step 1.

result.summary: Type E prose design written to src/design/fix-ISS-0074.md: real two-layer envelope encryption using std.crypto.aead.aes_gcm.Aes256Gcm (DEK encrypts plaintext; DEK wrapped by master_key via a second AEAD layer since Zig stdlib has no AES-KW primitive). No public signature changes, no caller changes, no migration needed. Fix scope: 1 file.
